This file previously carried an invented 4.9 rating from 38 reviews, four invented category scores and three reviews under the name 'PLACEHOLDER Reviewer' — all of it rendering on the homepage and the About page, and the rating in the mega menu on every page of the site. Fabricated reviews are not a placeholder that can ship, so the values are gone rather than reworded.

To turn the blocks back on: set profileUrl to the real Google Business Profile, rating and count to what that profile actually shows on the date in updatedAt, and paste 4 to 6 reviews exactly as written with the reviewer's name and date. Reviews are never edited or selected (spec Template 9). The homepage and About sections, and the nav link, reappear on their own once rating and reviews are present.
AggregateRating JSON-LD stays off until these values are real and kept in sync with the profile; lib/jsonld.ts has the switch.
textHi is a person's translation only where the original is English; a review written in Hindi is shown in Hindi as written.
